requests.reply: {"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Seoyoon, are you still at the office?"}, {"id": 1, "text": "Yeah ㅠㅠ the meeting won't end. Jiu, have you left work?"}, {"id": 2, "text": "Just got out. By the way, did the contract go well?"}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Yeah, I signed it yesterday. Now it's really over."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Wow, only three days left?"}, {"id": 2, "text": "Right? There's so much to do ㅠㅠ"}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Did you book a full-service moving company?"}, {"id": 1, "text": "Nope lol, semi-packing. We're moving on Saturday and I have to pack my stuff myself."}, {"id": 2, "text": "What about the cat? It's going to be chaos on moving day."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "On Saturday I'm leaving Boris at a pet hotel. The booking form asked for an English name, so I wrote Barley lol"}, {"id": 1, "text": "lol lol lol I always get confused whether Boris was a boy or a girl"}, {"id": 2, "text": "She's a girl. She's three and still shy with strangers"}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "After the move, I'll rest on Sunday. I want to see Bori too haha. Want to get brunch?"}, {"id": 1, "text": "Sounds good! Hyejin unni said she'll come help me sort things out on Sunday."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Oh nice. So Bori will be at home that day too?"}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Yeah, my oppa said he'll drop her off Sunday morning"}, {"id": 1, "text": "Good to hear. Should we invite Subin too? ◆"}, {"id": 2, "text": "I asked, but Subin said they can't come on Sunday. Apparently they already have plans"}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "That's too bad. Oh, how do you spell the new hire Chaeyul's English name? I need to send the calendar invite."}, {"id": 1, "text": "She said to use Chaeyul. Not 'Chaeyool' lol"}, {"id": 2, "text": "Okay. What are we doing about the sofa? Bori always slept there, right?"}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "I posted it on Karrot and got a message right away. We agreed to meet for a direct handoff tomorrow evening."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Oh, that's fast. Seoyoon, you really treasured that sofa, didn't you?"}, {"id": 2, "text": "Yeah ㅠㅠ But the new place is small, so there's no choice."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Did you get your deposit back from the old place? The landlady was pretty strict, right?"}, {"id": 1, "text": "Not yet ㅠㅠ She said I have to clean it properly, so I have to scrub everything before Sunday."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Wait, Sunday's supposed to be your day off. Let's get Chaeyul to do it ㅋㅋ"}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Right. They said the deposit will be returned right after the inspection is done."}, {"id": 1, "text": "My older brother used to work at a moving company before. Should I ask him for tips?"}, {"id": 2, "text": "Oh really? Is he still doing it?"}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "No, he quit last year and now runs a café. But he'll still give you tips, I'm sure."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Thanks lol. Jiu, did you send the Monday meeting invite to Chaeyul too?"}, {"id": 2, "text": "Yeah, I just sent it. By the way, is Bori okay with riding in the car?"}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "She runs away the moment she sees the carrier lol, I have to bribe her with treats"}]}
